2609.24847.title: SPECTRA: Adaptive Execution of Speculative Decoding on a Runtime-Reconfigurable Tiled Architecture
2609.24847.paper_summary: LLM inference on edge devices is constrained by computational and memory resources, making efficient autoregressive decoding challenging. Speculative decoding alleviates this bottleneck by generating tokens with a smaller draft model and verifying multiple tokens in parallel with a batched target model pass. However, verification introduces a runtime-dependent intermediate regime between memory-bound general matrix-vector (GEMV) operations in decoding and compute-bound general matrix-matrix (GEMM) operations in prefill, as its arithmetic intensity varies with speculation length and acceptance rate. We present SPECTRA, a runtime-reconfigurable tiled architecture that sustains high utilization across the full speculative decoding pipeline. Within each tile, the compute engine switches between systolic execution for GEMMs and vector-lane execution for GEMVs. Across tiles, SPECTRA dynamically adapts computation parallelism by selecting tile count, kernel partitioning, and communication pattern. Both tile-level and system-level reconfiguration operate on a per-kernel basis, enabling efficient execution across these diverse regimes. Evaluated on a 20-tile FPGA prototype across the Pythia, SmolLM2, and GPT-2 families, SPECTRA achieves up to $2.09\times$ speedup from tile-level reconfiguration and a further $1.25\times$ gain from system-level adaptability over fixed designs.
2609.24847.paper_summary_zh: LLM 推理在邊緣設備上受到計算和記憶體資源的限制，使得高效的自回歸解碼變得具有挑戰性。推測解碼通過使用較小的草稿模型生成標記，並與批次目標模型傳遞並行驗證多個標記，來緩解這一瓶頸。然而，驗證在解碼中的記憶體綁定一般矩陣-向量（GEMV）操作和在預填充中的計算綁定一般矩陣-矩陣（GEMM）操作之間引入了一個依賴於運行時的中介狀態，因為其算術強度隨著推測長度和接受率而變化。我們提出了 SPECTRA，一種運行時可重新配置的平鋪架構，能夠在整個推測解碼管道中保持高利用率。在每個平鋪內，計算引擎在 GEMM 的脈動執行和 GEMV 的向量通道執行之間切換。在平鋪之間，SPECTRA 通過選擇平鋪數量、內核分區和通信模式動態調整計算並行性。平鋪級和系統級的重新配置都是基於每個內核進行操作，從而實現這些多樣化狀態下的高效執行。在 Pythia、SmolLM2 和 GPT-2 系列上評估的 20 平鋪 FPGA 原型中，SPECTRA 通過平鋪級重新配置實現了高達 $2.09\times$ 的加速，並且通過系統級適應性在固定設計上進一步獲得了 $1.25\times$ 的增益。
